title: Automated Testing for the Service
objective: Build a test suite that covers the service's real failure modes, not just its happy path, running against a real PostgreSQL test database.
whyThisMatters: A test suite that only exercises success cases will pass right up until the first real user sends something unexpected. Mentors will look for failure-mode coverage specifically, not just a green run.
evidence: Git history showing tests added incrementally alongside or after each feature
Full test run output (for example pytest -v) pasted into the evidence note
The coverage report output or file
README section explaining any deliberately untested area
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests run against a real PostgreSQL instance and reset its state between runs.
At least two tests intentionally trigger a failure mode and assert on the resulting error, not just the happy path.
The transaction rollback behavior from the previous task has a dedicated test that fails if the rollback is removed.
A coverage report is generated and any gap over 10% in a core module is explained in the README.
